summary.zh-CN: 用数据库只读账号执行一条参数化 SELECT 并分批返回有界结果。
summary.en: Execute one parameterized SELECT with a database read-only account and return bounded batches.

details.zh-CN: 在只读事务中设置查询超时，拒绝多语句、写语句、DDL 与存储过程，并通过行数、单元格与输出字节上限约束结果。
details.en: Sets a query timeout in a read-only transaction, rejects multiple statements, writes, DDL and procedures, and bounds results by row, cell and output-byte limits.

input_summary.zh-CN: 一条占位符参数化 SELECT 和位置参数数组。
input_summary.en: One placeholder-parameterized SELECT and positional parameter array.

output_summary.zh-CN: JSON-safe 字段对象行、读取计数、partial/checkpoint 与脱敏错误。
output_summary.en: JSON-safe field-object rows, read count, partial/checkpoint state and redacted error.

risk.zh-CN: 必须使用数据库侧只读账号；客户端检查不能替代数据库权限。
risk.en: A database-enforced read-only account is mandatory; client checks do not replace database permissions.

install_notes.zh-CN: 建议依赖：psycopg[binary]==3.2.9。复制模板不会安装依赖；请先选择兼容 Worker，再按平台依赖流程安装并核验来源。
install_notes.en: Suggested dependencies: psycopg[binary]==3.2.9. Copying the template does not install them; first select a compatible Worker, then install through the platform dependency flow and verify the source.

input_skeleton.sql: SELECT id, name FROM example_items WHERE updated_at >= %s

input_contract.driver_rule: one parameterized SELECT in a read-only transaction with bounded cursor batches; multiple statements are rejected before execution
input_contract.identifier_rule: identifiers are fixed in reviewed SQL, never interpolated from unvalidated input

output_contract.error: stable database_connection_failed or database_query_failed category only; no DSN, SQL parameters, driver message or password
output_contract.column_rule: duplicate column labels are rejected before any result row is published
output_contract.cell_encoding: decimals and unsafe integers use lossless strings; temporal values use ISO 8601 with the session fixed to UTC; UUID uses text; binary uses {$binary_base64: base64}
output_contract.checkpoint: row_offset is the count of complete JSON-safe rows already published

runtime_guidance.zh-CN: 模板复制后默认停止。为 python 选择兼容 Worker；Secret 键仅通过 Credential Binding 提供：POSTGRES_DSN。在数据库中强制只读角色和只读事务；复制不会创建账号或安装驱动。
runtime_guidance.en: The copied template is stopped by default. Select a compatible python Worker. Secret keys are supplied only through Credential Binding: POSTGRES_DSN. Enforce a read-only role and transaction in the database; copying does not create an account or install the driver.
